thread:
iris: quick flag from onboarding: Zenith-14B int4 snapshot shows summarization brevity + factual errors vs fp16 on our news+policy mix. Small repro attached.
malik: thanks. is this at sampling or a deterministic eval? any exporter warnings in the conversion log?
iris: deterministic rouge eval. exporter v0.10.0, flags: --recipe=gptq-per-channel --append-sentinels auto. conversion log: 
```
WARN: appended 3 sentinels to vocab tail; remapped collisions by +1
WARN: mappings.json not emitted (legacy exporter path)
```
dean: mappings.json missing is immediate footgun. If special token indices changed, prompt prefixes will be wrong and KV cache alignment will be off. Any runtime logs?
iris: streaming smoke shows kv warnings: 
```
KV map mismatch at step 64: expected cols=256 got cols=255 -- dropping last col
Token mismatch: <sep> tokenizer_id=60011 embedding_id=60012
```
malik: two cascading problems: 1) special token shift; 2) KV column off-by-one. Combined with Zenith's headwise rotary_scale array (non-uniform), that can amplify wrong attention.
rachel: what does the rotary header look like? if head ordering/permutation differs between exporter and runtime, you'll see subtle long-context drift.
iris: header dump snippet: 
```
rotary_heads: 32
rotary_scale_per_head: [1.0,0.93,0.93,1.0,0.85,0.85,1.0,...]
rotary_head_perm: [0,1,3,2,4,5,7,6,...]
first_tokens: [1, 101, 60011, 502, 60013]
```
dean: exporter appending sentinels likely pushed 60011->60012 etc. If runtime used unchanged rotary_head_perm while exporter reordered head dims, freq mapping could be misapplied.
malik: short test: locally remap tokenizer ids to embedding ids for the three sentinels and rerun a 300-sample eval. If Rouge/ROUGE-L recovers close to fp16, mapping is main culprit.
iris: did that - remap (-1) for three tokens -> rouge-L improved from 0.29 -> 0.385 (fp16 baseline 0.39). So mapping explains most of the hit. But long-context (>4096) still sees an 6-8% gap.
rachel: that remaining gap smells like either: a) rotary-head index permutation mismatch over long sequences, or b) quant recipe sensitivity in attention projection matrices at scale. Run quant ablation: per-channel vs per-tensor symmetric + awq 4-bit.
dean: also instrument kv->token and kv->head mapping during a long stream: log per-step which embedding index occupies kv column t and which rotary head freq applied. If we see drift after wrap-around, that's our bug.
qa-bot: created ISSUE: exporter/emit-mapping-json-1745556666 (#17512)
exporter-bot: note: older exporters had a fallback that silently remapped ids and did not write mapping.json; proposed patch: always emit mapping.json and run post-export check comparing tokenizer.special_ids -> embeddings.index_of for exported snapshot.
malik: next actions: 1) hotfix snapshot with manual remap so downstream tests pass (iris) 2) exporter patch to always emit mapping.json + CI assert (exporter-bot / rachel) 3) run ablation per-channel vs per-tensor vs awq on 400 long-context samples (malik) 4) instrument kv<->rotary trace and replay a failing long-context session (dean).
iris: I'll upload the patched snapshot and post links. Thanks all :sparkles:
